brief: Card illustration for card 'Basic Attack' (ATTACK): Deal 7 damage.
Card illustration for card 'Basic Block' (SKILL): Gain 5 block.

Card illustration for card 'Cell Wall' (SKILL): Convert Block into Overshield
Card illustration for card 'Chloroplast' (ATTACK): Do [damage] to all enemies. Ethereal. On exhaust, do 10 damage to everyone.
Card illustration for card 'Clippers' (ATTACK): Attack for [damage] damage [number_of_attacks] times. Gain [status_charge_amount] Strength. On pickup, Gain [health_amount] HP.
Card illustration for card 'Differentiation' (ATTACK): Do [attack_damage]. Lose [self_damage] HP.
Card illustration for card 'Fertilize' (SKILL): Gain {0}{0}. Lose [self_damage] HP.
Card illustration for card 'Fruit' (SKILL): Randomly gain [small_max_health_amount] Max HP, [big_max_health_amount] Max HP, or {0}

Card illustration for card 'Moss' (ATTACK): Gain [status_charge_amount]. Deal damage equal to Overshield.
Card illustration for card 'Pollen' (POWER): Take [status_charge_amount] damage at the start of your turn and draw [status_secondary_charge_amount] cards

Card illustration for card 'Reap' (ATTACK): Attack for [damage] damage and gain Overshield for unblocked damage\nExhaust
Card illustration for card 'Wildflower' (ATTACK): Attack for [damage] damage. Costs 0 if damage was taken this turn.
Card illustration for card 'Symbiosis' (POWER): Overshield no longer decays
Card illustration for card 'Thorns' (SKILL): Gain [block] Block and [status_charge_amount] Pointy
Card illustration for card 'Verdant' (SKILL): When drawn, cap incoming damage to [status_secondary_charge_amount] for [status_charge_amount] and Exhaust.
Card illustration for card 'Vines' (ATTACK): Do [damage] to all enemies [number_of_attacks] times. Not affected by Pointy
Card illustration for card 'Conclusion' (ATTACK): Retain. Do [damage]. Gain 4 damage for each unused energy at turn end. Exhaust
Card illustration for card 'Datum' (SKILL): Gain [block] Block. Duplicates on draw. Exhaust.
Card illustration for card 'Photoelectric Synthesis' (POWER): Gain 10 strength. Cannot be played unless it has Absorbed 5 energy. [card_absorbed_energy] Absorbed.
Card illustration for card 'Big Boom' (ATTACK): Do [damage] damage to all enemies. Gain [status_charge_amount] Overheat.
Card illustration for card 'Containment' (SKILL): Gain [block] Block. Add [number_of_cards] Wastes to hand
Card illustration for card 'Critical' (POWER): Gain [status_charge_amount] Overheat each turn.
Card illustration for card 'Feedback Loop' (POWER): Gain {0} whenever you Overheat.
Card illustration for card 'Special Discard' (ATTACK): Do [damage] damage for each Waste card in your exhaust pile. Add 1 Waste to your hand.
Card illustration for card 'Meltdown' (ATTACK): Do [damage] damage. Gain [status_charge_amount] Overheat.
Card illustration for card 'Particle Accelerator' (SKILL): Gain [energy_amount] Energy. Add [number_of_cards] Wastes to discard pile.
Card illustration for card 'Unstable' (SKILL): Draw [draw_count] cards. Gain [status_charge_amount] Overheat
Card illustration for card 'Waste' (STATUS): At end of turn gain [status_charge_amount] Overheat and do [damage] damage to a random enemy. Exhaust

Card frame for ATTACK cards. Portrait 144:184. Upper square art window (about x 17%-83%, y 6%-59%) and lower text plate (y 61%-98%) must be plain dark flat areas so art/text can be overlaid. Cost gem slot at top-left corner.
